test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following chart shows the expenditure of a house on various heads. The total expenditure of the house is Rs. 85,200. Study the chart and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72e672957f17264bc79e7bfd986aebadfaa0a5a67386c94e2c6b995b954a9511.png] 

How much more amount is spent on ration than on rent?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Money spends on ration is 36%.

Money spends on Rent is 20%.

Difference = 36% - 20% = 16%

According to the question.

16% of 85,200 = Rs. 13,632

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
